title: Capture local HTTPS setup guide screenshots
description:
Problem: the local HTTPS setup guide contains placeholder IDs but does not yet include final visual examples.

Desired outcome: capture the complete local HTTPS walkthrough images and embed them in `guides/https-setup`.

Scope:
- In scope: collect screenshots for `HTTPS-SETUP-01` through `HTTPS-SETUP-06`, store under `Data/Pages/assets`, and replace placeholders with markdown image links.
- Out of scope: production reverse proxy/IIS evidence (covered by a separate task).

Acceptance criteria:
- Each HTTPS setup placeholder ID has a matching image and in-guide embed.
- Browser lock/certificate and readiness examples are clearly legible.
- No private account details or secrets appear in captures.

Validation:
- Render `guides/https-setup` in `/pages` and verify all images load and sequence matches the steps.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track local HTTPS screenshot capture for HTTPS-SETUP placeholders.
